east_catalysts_risks.notes: The Hindu lead (Pink Line approval within five days; Blue Line trials by October-end) was blocked, but Asianet Newsable (23 Oct) and The Bengaluru Live (22 Oct) report the same minister statements. The Deccan Herald original was also blocked (403). The Indian Express KR Puram–Silk Board lead was not reachable. The Trade Brains lead's Sarjapur/Devanahalli detail was not confirmed: Realty Today gives no locality breakdown. The Blue Line trial timing conflicts: the minister said end-October (22 Oct), while the BMRCL MD said 15 November (19 Oct). I found nothing dated in the window on Varthur/Bellandur flooding, Cauvery supply, the Bengaluru Business Corridor/PRR, the Sarjapur–Hebbal metro approval, ORR white-topping start, or Whitefield leasing. Searches returned only older background, so I did not report those. The ORR white-topping dispute (ORRCA, August 2026) and the Sarjapur–Hebbal DPR (central approval pending) are stale background that I did not log as claims.

east_launches_prices.notes: Thin window for confirmed East Bengaluru launches. No developer press release or RERA-portal-verified new villa, plotted or apartment launch dated 21–24 Oct 2026 was found. In-window items: Prestige's H2 FY27 pipeline coverage (22–23 Oct, Trade Brains/Indian Opinion; Trade Brains gives Whitefield and Sarjapur projects but no RERA numbers), Sattva Whitefield page update (20 Oct, just before window), and STRR Hoskote–Hosur reports (22–23 Oct). Not obtained: The Hindu Pink Line article (domain blocked), Deccan Herald Blue Line article (403; headline only), Indian Express KR Puram–Silk Board, The Bengaluru Live airport-metro piece. Metro timing conflict: minister's October-end target (DH, 22 Oct) vs BMRCL MD's 15 November target (Oneindia, 19 Oct). Unverified leads seen only in search snippets and not reported as claims: Brigade Granada (Whitefield–Hoskote Rd, 20.19-acre purchase for ₹588 crore reported 11 Sep), NVT Villas pre-launch (Varthur-Sarjapur), Brigade Gunjur. RERA numbers were not checked on rera.karnataka.gov.in; the search tool cannot access several major domains (thehindu, TOI, Moneycontrol, HT, NIE).

government_watch.notes: Thin coverage: Deccan Herald, The Hindu, Hindustan Times and Business Standard blocked WebFetch, so DH/Hindu/HT items rest on headlines or search-engine summaries only. Search summaries suggested (unverified, no verbatim excerpt available): DH 22 Oct reported B-SMILE re-tendered six flyover projects worth ~Rs 1,500 crore with fresh bids for three more due within a week; DH 24 Oct said roads of 30–100 ft around lakes would be folded into RMP 2015 with 60 days for objections. Not located: LiveLawBiz REAT article, Business Standard EMI article, Public TV e-PID article, the IBM-Bagmane lease details (IBM 2.83 lakh sq ft, Rs 343 crore over 10 years per HT headline, not verified). No in-window official BMRCL/BDA/GBA/KRERA/cabinet/stamp-duty pages found. The Asianet piece conflicts with the Hindu/DH reports only in being the sole source for the July 2027 target; treat Blue Line dates as unsettled across sources. Official agency sites were not fetched.

market_baseline.notes: Baseline pass; several key pages were 403 (Deccan Herald, BusinessWorld, JLL Homes blog) and the Anarock Q2 PDF was unreadable. Not reported for lack of verbatim support: Knight Frank H1 2026 Bengaluru (27,968 sales, 34,749 launches), JLL Q2 2026 (prices +3.1% QoQ, rents +2.5% QoQ, launches concentrated on Bellary Road/Hosur Road/Whitefield), Anarock Thanisandra/Sarjapur prices (Rs 8,900 and Rs 9,850 psf at end-2024), and Devanahalli plot rates. The Devanahalli figures (about Rs 4,500–10,000 psf in 2026) came only from developer/portal blogs and are asking-price level. Rental-yield figures (about 3–5.5%) came only from developer blogs and JLL Homes, so I treated them as unverified. Sources disagree on Bengaluru Q2 2026 sales (15,285 vs 14,186 vs about 17,000) because of differing methodologies. No Colliers, CBRE, NHB RESIDEX or PropEquity Bengaluru-specific Q3 2026 figures were found. The PropEquity 16,840-unit figure is from Q3 2025, so it is not in-period.

metro_watch.notes: Window yielded one main development: the 22–23 Oct Pink Line status (awaiting Centre's nod, BMRCL expects clearance in 4–5 days, no opening date) and new Blue Line targets. Excerpts for the Asianet claims are partly drawn from the search summary and the fetched page; the fetched page paraphrased, so verify wording before quoting. Deccan Herald (Krishna Byre Gowda review; Phase 3 Centre approval in ~20 days; Hebbal–Airport June 2027) was seen only in search snippets and blocked on fetch (403), so it is not reported as a claim; its figures conflict with Asianet (Nov 2027 vs June 2027), so flag as unresolved. No window-dated K-RIDE, fare, ridership, Red Line tender, or CMRS-authorisation news found. The B-SMILE Indiranagar flyover story was not located. bmrc.co.in and kride.in were not fetched.

north_south_west.notes: Thin window. thehindu.com and indianexpress.com were not fetchable or searchable here, so the Hindu/IE/DH leads were not verified at source. Pink Line approval, Blue Line trial runs and airport metro timelines (Oct 22-23 leads) were not confirmed from an in-window article; only August 2026 background was found, with dates that conflict across outlets. Business Standard (22 Oct 2026) reportedly covers Bhartiya Urban and Alpine's Nikoo Homes 9 (about 1,584 units, over Rs 1,000 crore investment, North Bengaluru). The page returned 403, and promotional pages place the project at Bagalur, so I did not report it as a claim. The Prestige Olive Oak villa-plot township (Yelahanka Extension) has a listing-only launch of 10 Dec 2026, unverified. No in-window villa or plot launches were verified for Kanakapura Road, Bidadi, Hoskote, Doddaballapur, Mysore Road, Tumkur Road or Hosur Road. Leads on ganja seizures, SpiceJet delays, the Apache price and the airport video are irrelevant. The NGT order was reported by The Hindu on 19 Oct (headline only).

social_signals.notes: No in-window (21–24 Oct 2026) social-media content found. Reddit and old.reddit were blocked to the fetch tool; YouTube search returned no results (JS-rendered); LinkedIn required login; Deccan Herald returned 403. Web searches (12 queries, including site-targeted for reddit, youtube, linkedin, thehindu) returned only developer blogs/listing pages (Sobha, Brigade, Godrej, NBR, Puravankara), which are interested-party marketing and undated or outside the window, so not reported as claims. The only relevant material is two pre-window background items on the Blue Line (ORR) metro, whose October trial-run target appears to have slipped to ~15 Nov per a 16 Oct report; no in-window confirmation that trials started. A returned snippet on Arvind SmartSpaces (Nagondanahalli, Whitefield) and Brigade Avalon launches had no shown dates and was not verified. Valid result: nothing new verified for the window.
